item.title: What is ShadowTalk AI?
item.description: ShadowTalk AI is an agentic AI workspace at shadowtalk-ai.com that combines encrypted chat, voice mode, a code IDE, and optional on-device offline models in one product. It is built to finish multi-step jobs—not just single chat replies—and offers a free tier with no credit card.

item.title: What is ShadowTalk's tagline?
item.description: ShadowTalk's tagline is "Think AI. Think ShadowTalk." The product positions itself as a sovereign, high-performance agentic workspace for builders, developers, and power users.

item.title: Who should use ShadowTalk AI?
item.description: ShadowTalk AI is designed for developers, founders, researchers, cybersecurity professionals, students, and teams who want one workspace for chat, code, deep research, presentations, and privacy controls—without juggling ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity in separate tabs.

item.title: Is ShadowTalk a ChatGPT wrapper?
item.description: No. ShadowTalk AI is not a thin ChatGPT wrapper—it chains tools from natural language, includes a browser IDE, marketplace agents, BYOK API keys, and optional on-device inference. The architecture is an agentic workspace, not a reskinned chat API.
